There is a small, ambiguous black protrusion or drip-like shape at the very bottom center of the housing. It does not clearly correspond to a standard bolt or drain hole and looks like a minor geometric generation error.
The edges of the visors are slightly soft compared to the sharpness of the mast arm, suggesting minor rendering inconsistency or depth-of-field simulation issues.
